description: Individual payments and refunds — Reports → Transactions. This is the PAYMENT level, not the order level: one order can hold several transactions. Answers 'find the payment for receipt 1042', 'show every Amex refund last week', 'which transactions failed'. Filter by payment method, processor, card provider or status, or search by order number. For sales figures use get_financial_summary — this tool is for locating a specific payment.

endDate.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Inclusive of the day when a bare date is given

stations.description: Station ids to restrict to. Omit for all stations
